target.statement: Mean ARI of KMP (neighborhood-smoothed profile K-means) at n=1500 on the weak-layered D directed SBM design, reported as 0.842 (vs KMA 0.746)
target.dataset: Synthetic directed SBM, weak-layered D block matrix, n=1500, K=5, gamma_n=1, MC=100 replicates

compute.basis: Synthetic data is trivially generated, but no code is released: the agent must reimplement landmark neighborhood smoothing (O(n^2 m) dissimilarities, m=128, n=1500), quantile neighborhoods with tie retention, and 20-init K-means++ for 4 methods x 100 replicates; the exact block matrix 'weak-layered D' is only partially specified (mean prob 0.11, a(B)=0.641, delta_row=0.119, trailing singular values) so exact ARI 0.842 is unlikely to be matched bit-for-bit.

blockers: No code or supplementary repository released; only a link to the unrelated OpenWorm ConnectomeToolbox
Block matrices (e.g. weak-layered D) are not given explicitly, only summary diagnostics, so exact numerical reproduction of 0.842 is not guaranteed
Requires reimplementing the full simulation protocol (4 methods, 100 paired replicates, 8 network sizes) from prose
title: Exact Recovery by Neighborhood Smoothing in Directed Stochastic Block Models
